_comment: Battle-menu labels. UIIconBtn.UpdateBtn resolves titles[type] through StringSet.GetUIString; hooking that load lets the cave substitute its own strings. ids 581 (UI_KILL) and 298 (UI_BTN_KAMCORD_STOP) become '1-Hit' and 'Stop'; type 23 (Support) branches to the drop-rate label cave in native_droprate.json. Strings are built with il2cpp_string_new from ASCII in the cave padding, so no metadata literal is rewritten.

patches.note: UpdateBtn: titles[type] load -> label cave (ids 581/298, type 23)
label cave: 1-Hit / Stop, and type 23 -> drop-rate label cave
